about: What the launcher offers to install. tools/release/make_features.py packs each feature's paths into .tar parts (under 2 GB each, for GitHub release assets) and writes manifest.json with their sizes and SHA-256.

features.name: Today's rosters (2026)
features.description: Every club's current players, with ratings worked out from their real statistics, today's managers and the 2026 schedule. The commentators say the surnames of about 850 new players with their own recordings.

features.name: Player portraits
features.description: A portrait for every player on today's rosters, rendered from his own face and uniform, in place of the game's generic heads.

features.name: Today's uniforms
features.description: Each club's home and road uniforms become the closest match to what it wears today, from the game's own wardrobe: throwbacks that came back, new colours and jerseys that fit the club's name.

features.name: Today's ballparks
features.description: Today's park names, and outfields reshaped to today's fence distances where the fences moved or the club moved to a new park.

features.name: 2026 rules for CPU play
features.description: Computer-controlled clubs play by today's rules: no extreme shifts, a quicker pace (pitch clock), more steals with the bigger bases, and the universal DH.

features.name: Varied head shapes
features.description: The game's 15 generic heads each get their own jaw, cheekbones and chin, so created and generated players don't all look alike.

features.name: HD texture pack (4x)
features.description: Every texture on the disc redrawn at four times its resolution with a Real-ESRGAN upscale and repairs for colour, grain, seams and lettering: uniforms, faces, ballparks, crowds, logos and menus. Best at internal resolution 3x or 4x.

features.name: HD texture pack (2x, smaller)
features.description: The same pack at twice the original resolution: a quarter of the size, nearly all of the look at 1080p. Pick this one if disk space or download time matters.
